1\. Custom provider hook bypassed 🐞 Bug ≡ Correctness 
Passing self.untag as object_hook prevents custom JSON providers from installing their own
object hook, so provider-specific values remain undecoded during tagged or session deserialization.
Providers backed by libraries that do not accept Python's object_hook keyword may instead fail
every load with an exception.
Agent Prompt ``` ## Issue description `TaggedJSONSerializer.loads` now passes `object_hook=self.untag` through Flask's configurable JSON provider. This overrides provider-defined hooks and may pass an unsupported Python-specific keyword to alternate JSON implementations. ## Issue Context Previously, the provider completed its normal deserialization before tagged dictionaries were recursively converted. Preserve that ordering and avoid requiring custom providers to support or compose an `object_hook` argument. ## Fix Focus Areas - src/flask/json/tag.py[297-315] - src/flask/json/__init__.py[77-105] - tests/test_json.py[223-245] ``` ⓘ Copy this prompt and use it to remediate the issue with your preferred AI generation tools
